verdict.summary: No blocking defect was found. The exclusive full-development cache is bound to the exact public road train/val manifest, normalized row/content identities, every raw source SHA, preprocessing source/library identity, a whole-blob SHA and per-record SHA values. The final report records exact comparison of every single-frame centered RGB input, target, ignore region and key, plus bounded Mosaic checks. An actual pinned-cache cnn.train CPU validate-only invocation accepted the cache and created no run output; it did not execute a batch, loss, optimizer or training step.

builder_guard_review.default_limit: MAX_PILOT_IMAGES is 128; the normal CLI and build_cache default reject more than 128 rows.
builder_guard_review.explicit_full_gate: Only --full-development selects the full builder, and --dataset-sha256 is mandatory there. Supplying the receipt without the full flag is rejected.
builder_guard_review.receipt_timing: The exact manifest receipt is checked before manifest audit/source decoding and again after load_dataset_manifest. The manifest is also rechecked after cache construction and after verification.
builder_guard_review.qa_rejection: Known cache-QA manifests are rejected before load_dataset_manifest and therefore before source-pixel access.
builder_guard_review.newtest_rejection: Any declared split outside train/val is rejected before load_dataset_manifest; the unit test verifies the loader is not called for a newtest manifest.
builder_guard_review.all_rows_required: Full mode requires the normalized row count to equal every declared development row; a subset is rejected.
builder_guard_review.exclusive_publication: The cache directory and blob are created exclusively. rgb.bin is flushed and fsynced; preprocessing and manifest identities are rechecked; index.pending.json is flushed and fsynced and only then renamed to index.json. Existing or interrupted target directories are not overwritten.
builder_guard_review.reader_integrity: The reader hashes exact index bytes before parsing, checks manifest/content/preprocessing/row/source/offset identities, hashes every current raw source during construction, checks blob size and whole-blob SHA, and checks the selected record SHA on every _load.

full_equivalence_evidence.compared_fields: centered RGB input, boxes, labels, ignore_boxes and teacher/sample key

independent_checks.coverage_note: Includes default limit, explicit full bypass, subset rejection, QA rejection, dataset receipt mismatch, newtest-before-loader rejection, disk-reserve rejection and existing cache corruption/identity cases.

independent_checks.result: All 24201 image names, contiguous offsets, normalized row fingerprints and source bindings matched; recomputed content hash and final byte extent matched the index.

independent_checks.timing_note: Wall time was not instrumented independently and is not used as performance evidence; startup includes full manifest/source/cache integrity validation.

findings.evidence: index.json is safely published after complete cache construction, but before the subsequent all-frame raw-versus-cache equivalence loop finishes.
findings.disposition: For full-development adoption, require both the pinned index SHA and the final passed builder report. Do not interpret index existence alone as proof that all-frame equivalence completed.

findings.evidence: Every single-frame train/val item was compared, but Mosaic comparison covers only 32 evenly spaced train indices at each of epochs 6 and 7.
findings.disposition: Do not claim exhaustive Mosaic, worker-shuffle or full-epoch equivalence from this report.

findings.evidence: The actual trainer invocation validates startup identities only. Build and verification times are cache preparation/QA times, not training throughput.
findings.disposition: No claim is supported for batches, loss, gradients, optimizer/scheduler, effective batch 64, DataLoader worker memory/order, GPU AMP, epoch timing, accuracy or FPGA behavior. Keep cached training opt-in and require separately observed target-run startup, memory and end-to-end timing before adoption.

findings.evidence: The cache contains only the 19050 train and 5151 val rows from the pinned VisDrone development manifest and no newtest row.
findings.disposition: This is public development preprocessing evidence only. It does not inspect or make any claim about blind/newtest data and does not itself authorize GPU resume.

final_process_state: The dedicated validate-only process exited. The requested output path did not exist after exit; no reviewer-started training process remained.
